source_defined_two_mode_criterion.physical_distinction: The physical distinction used in the later dissertation analysis is whether the combustor thermal throat is critical.
source_defined_two_mode_criterion.transition_boundary: thermal throat is exactly critical, Ma=1, at the equivalence ratio defining the mode-transition boundary for a fixed incoming condition
source_defined_two_mode_criterion.boundary_interpretation: At fixed flight Mach, the transition boundary is the maximum equivalence ratio at which the engine can remain on the scram side, equivalently the minimum equivalence ratio for the ram side.

variables.Ma_s: Mach number at the combustor maximum-pressure location
variables.Ma_2: isolator/combustor upstream Mach number used by the dissertation criterion
variables.Ma_3m: supersonic characteristic combustor-inlet Mach number when a sonic section exists
variables.Ma_2min: minimum allowable combustor-inlet Mach number, obtained from Ma_3p across a normal shock

physical_annotations.no_shock_scram: no shock train, unseparated boundary layer, thermal throat not choked
physical_annotations.oblique_shock_scram: oblique/weaker precombustion shock train, separated boundary layer, thermal throat not choked
physical_annotations.ram: normal/strong shock train, separated boundary layer, thermal throat choked

integration_policy.reason: The current accepted project-defined combustor path does not yet provide the dissertation's full isolator shock-train state variables Ma_2, Ma_s, Ma_3m and Ma_2min with source-compatible geometry/conventions.
integration_policy.numerical_sonic_tolerance: PROJECT_CHOICE_REQUIRED_EXPLICITLY; the source defines Ma=1 but does not prescribe a numerical floating-point tolerance.
integration_policy.guard_policy: A forward-flow solver guard or nonconvergence is not a mode label. Apply the source criterion only to an admissible converged solution.
integration_policy.claim_policy: Applying this source-defined thermal-throat criterion to the project-defined geometry is a project application of a source criterion, not a Cao Case 2 reproduction.
